sections.heading: Description
lines: Inverse Field is one of the fields present in Rejuvenation. It is categorized as an Magical field and can be found in the Grand Dream Stadium, most notably during the battle against Adam in the Tournament Stadium.

sections.heading: General Effects
lines: The type chart is inverted, meaning weaknesses become resistances, and resistances and type immunities become weaknesses.

sections.heading: Abilities Affected
lines: Mimicry changes the user's type to Normal.

sections.heading: Moves Affected
lines: Camouflage changes the user's type to Normal.
Shelter halves damage from Normal-type moves.

sections.heading: Items
lines: Magical Seed changes the user's type to Normal and changes their ability to Normalize.

sections.heading: Other Notes
lines: As of v13.5.6, despite what the field effect manual says, Topsy-Turvy can no longer generate nor remove this field.
